ownership.root: one Luna MAIN; configured workers only in disjoint new files

budget.synthetic_fits: record separately as QA; never official-data research fits
budget.authorization: New cap of 60 applies only when the user launches the accompanying prompt; do not reset or spend this budget on the older campaign.
budget.fit_unit: One official-data estimator training call, including domain/router/quantile heads and started-unsaved calls. Learned preprocessing fits are separately logged, excluded from the 60 estimator-head cap, and must remain fit-only. Synthetic QA estimator fits are separately logged.

controls.classification: v3_cls_sparse25: .75 C2_B + .25 original SparseTextBoostClassifier on present; CatBoost missing; threshold .50
regression_secondary_report_only: R06_ORIGINAL; report against verified cache, not auto-promote based on public score

gates.scope: primary, H12, and EACH individual declared primary window; full-six includes W1..W6. Unsupported remains descriptive.

continuation_selection.classification_order: among candidates passing all pilot and matched-control gates, largest primary gain, then H12 gain, then more nonnegative pilot windows; exact tie N01 before N02
continuation_selection.regression_order: N03 first if it passes LATE gates and matched constant-arm gate; otherwise N04 if it passes STANDARD gates. Do not rank gains across profiles.

cards.question: Locate stable error mechanisms in verified expanded continuation without retraining.
implementation: Reconcile old campaign terminal checkpoint, bundles and verifier status; blocked historical R11 is not a model-performance failure.
Freeze CURRENT controls listed in queue; do not change baseline based on new public score.
Recompute row-aligned primary/H12, EF/impact/availability, per-cycle signs and disagreement for controls and valid expanded candidates; use fit-defined bins.
Compute fixed N03 arms A/B anew: B has missing fallback A=R22, unlike the previous legacy-missing combination. Store this policy difference explicitly.
Produce complete resource/dependency/cache map for all queued lanes and a smoke-test checklist before the first official fit.
cards.stop: Corrupt shared raw/control lineage stops dependent tasks; absent nonessential historical R11 does not stop the queue.
cards.verification_requirement: Require report status PASS plus independently recheck each used NPZ/sidecar hash, identity, frozen recipe, source rows/IDs, temporal bounds and prediction reconstruction. Report PASS is not performance-gate PASS. Absent/invalid optional candidate is excluded and reported; invalid shared control blocks its dependent tasks. Do not assume preflight checked C11/C17/R21 merely because their reports pass.
cards.r11_scope: Pilot-only diagnostic if verified; full-six technical blocker remains UNKNOWN. No full-six fabrication or retry in this phase.

cards.question: Do class-by-volume training weights add value beyond class rebalancing?

recipe.change: new adapter passes sample_weight to LGBMClassifier.fit; never edit original fit(X,y)
recipe.bins: np.quantile fit finite parsed text_load at [.25,.5,.75]; collapse duplicate edges; use side=right; missing bin only if present in fit; unseen missing => weight1 and report
recipe.weights: sqrt(n_fit/(2*G*n_class_bin)); clip [.5,2], normalize mean1; G is actual fit-bin count
recipe.class_control: for each y, mean candidate weight among that class; identical total class mass
recipe.policy: .75 frozen C2_B + .25 new sparse expert on present; frozen CB on missing; threshold .50

preconditions: every actual fit class-bin cell n>=100
all candidate weights finite positive; same class masses in control
cards.eligibility: task gates plus primary gain>=.0002 over class-only control

cards.question: Do degree-two interactions add information beyond the same main effects?

recipe.sketch_input: L2-normalized COPY of exact C2_B main-effect matrix; retain original main effects unchanged
recipe.design: CSR hstack original main effects + 1024 dense sketch columns converted safely to CSR; never densify raw TFIDF
recipe.policy: .75 current class route + .25 new expert on present; missing remains exact CB; threshold .50
recipe.no_sketch_control: same policy/head/preprocessing, no sketch; two counted fits even if C2_B reuse looks possible

preconditions: conservative full fit+score transform+solver peak fits RAM policy
cards.eligibility: task gates plus primary gain>=.0002 over no-sketch control

cards.question: Can a past-only router retain useful R22/R06 complementarity while avoiding harm?

recipe.rank: whole complete cycle, average ties, rank50=clip(.5 raw+.5 percentile,0,100)
recipe.router_target: abs(y-B)-abs(y-A) from unique primary OOF blocks ending <= outer cutoff
recipe.imputer: median from router FIT OOF rows; all-missing numeric =>0, record flag; no outer preprocessing fit
recipe.decision: choose B iff predicted loss difference < -.03; otherwise A
recipe.constant_control: choose B for all present iff mean PAST OOF loss difference < -.03; otherwise A
recipe.fallback: origin55 exact A by design; any origin below minimum support exact A, report support; no fabricated pre56 OOF

preconditions: verified R22/R06 raw arrays and exact legacy baseline at all six origins
join by source rows/IDs; select complete cycles, do not assume entire bundle shapes equal
minimum support at67/75; at least one router-routed row across pilot or report no benefit
smoke: future labels perturbation cannot change fitted head
cards.eligibility: LATE task gates vs A plus primary MAE gain>=.01 over past-only constant control; legacy group protection also passes

cards.question: Does feature-based covariate weighting help beyond allocation by time?

recipe.domain: last four FIT cycles pseudo-recent=1; older FIT cycles source=0; no future validation/Test features
recipe.domain_features: structured+word TFIDF; exclude record_id, explicit cycle_code and all task targets
recipe.domain_split: two folds by odd/even fit cycle; both domain classes required in each training and held-out fold; fit domain preprocessing separately on each training fold
recipe.weights: balanced-domain p => odds p/(1-p) is density ratio under equal effective prior; p clipped [1e-6,1-1e-6]; source odds clip [.25,4], recent weight1, normalize mean1
recipe.task_model: exact R22 design/parameters, only XGB.fit(sample_weight=weights) differs; new adapter, no frozen source edit
recipe.control: same task model with weights permuted WITHIN fit cycle, seed=42+cutoff
recipe.policy: replace raw_R22 in original R22 policy, retain .75 exact legacy champion +.25 rank50(new raw)

preconditions: domain pre-task checks pass before fitting task models
smoke: shuffled weights preserve exact per-cycle multiset
task transforms identical except estimator weights
cards.eligibility: task gates plus primary MAE gain>=.01 over shuffled-weight model; auxiliary domain fits count even if scientific pre-task skip

cards.question: Does conditional interval width characterize uncertainty beyond constant past-residual intervals?

recipe.model: two LGBMRegressor quantile heads on exact R22 structured/OHE+TFIDF/SVD32 design
recipe.preprocessing: one fit per origin shared by both quantile heads; no weighted task fits or early stopping
recipe.interval: record raw crossing; clip endpoints[0,100]; sort pair, report crossing rate before sort
recipe.control: A=R22 point score + q.1/q.9 of signed y-A from PAST unique primary OOF rows <=cutoff; clipped[0,100]

preconditions: four NEW quantile fits budgeted; saved R11 bundles lack survival probabilities
smoke: information lane cannot qualify as a point-prediction winner
cards.eligibility: information only; no auto continuation/router feature add-on/model promotion

cards.question: Does R06 depend on anonymous character surface beyond recurring token identity?

recipe.model: exact original R06 char sparse L1 recipe; only deterministic token bijection changes input stream

token_domains.q: q plus exactly7 hex digits (28-bit payload)
token_domains.z: z plus exactly6 hex digits (24-bit payload)

recipe.bijection: 6-round balanced Feistel on payload; halfbits14 for q,12 for z; round F = low halfbits of SHA256 UTF8('research_next_v1|seed|prefix|round|right_decimal'); (L,R)=(R,L xor F); retain prefix and zero-padded lowercase hex length
recipe.token_rule: regex full tokens with original boundaries; preserve all separators, order, multiplicity, missing mask; unexpected token shape => pre-fit schema skip, not guessed hashing
recipe.future_rule: mapping defined for entire numeric token domain, needs no future/Test lexicon or learned lookup
recipe.control: cached original R06 raw/policy; optional word-TFIDF invariance via explicitly remapped frozen vocabulary indices/IDF, no new model fit
recipe.policy: same .75 legacy champion +.25 rank50(renamed R06) as original, unchanged even if gate fails

preconditions: all Train tokenizer tokens fit q/z observed domains
bijection inversion/collision/length/prefix tests pass for both seeds
smoke: validation transformed with SAME mapping used during fit
no word-vocabulary tie selection claimed invariant unless indices preserved
cards.eligibility: information only; no score-seeking seed selection or automatic promotion
